en.html:
Sayo"Mr. Minato."
Kageaki"Yes."
Sayo"You must not let your heart collapse."
Kageaki"...?"
Sayo"If you do, you will lose the right to stand before my mistress. You will meet your death like an animal led to slaughter."
Sayo"...Why, I wonder. I feel I must not let that happen."
Kageaki"............"
Sayo"Whatever little help I can give... allow me."

en.html:
Her eyes still clear as ice, she leaned close and kissed my eyelids. Gently, as though sheltering them.

She took away my tears.

...Did she know?

Did this woman know why I was crying? Was that why she could stop it? Perhaps so.

Surely women possessed some wisdom of their own, something a foolish man could not understand. Understanding I had none; still, I entrusted myself to her.

She tended first one eye, then the other. It felt as though she was taking away not only the tears, but their very source.

女性は、俺の両脚の間に頭を沈ませた。
　そこの衣服を解き、内にあったものを解放する。

　白い指が触れると、その醜い部分は激しく反応した。
　血が通い、隆起する。

　生命的、というほかない<ruby>様<rt>さま</rt></ruby>だった。
　それは女性の求めるものであったのか。口元を微笑
の形にして、彼女は行為を促進する。

　緩やかな手つきで肉の塊を握り締め、軽く<ruby>摩<rt>さす</rt></ruby>る。
　わずかに力を加えて、揉むようにもする。

　女性の手に対して、俺の尖端は従順だった。
　一秒毎に体積を増し、その変化に逆行などない。

　意識が否応もなく、ただ一ヶ所の感覚に集中させら
れてゆくのを俺は自覚した。
　そこだけが過敏になり、他の全てが鈍磨する。

　女性は俺のそんな内面を見抜いたのかもしれない。
　やおら顔を近付けると、舌先を繰り出して肉の棒に
触れさせた。

　それまでとは異なる、鋭い刺激。
　俺の背筋がびくりと跳ねた。

　暴力的な。
　しかし決して抗うものを呼び起こしはしない交接。

　舌は尖端から<ruby>くびれ<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>、そして裏側へ、薄く唾液の跡
を残しながら這う。
　その行程が俺にもたらす快楽は、長く尾を引いた。

　甘たるい戦慄に、皮膚の毛が逆立つ。
　肺腑が収縮し、呼吸が早まる。

　素直な反応に気を良くしたものか、それとも予定に
従ってのことか、やがて女性は行為の速度を高めた。
　朱色の肉はあたかも独立した生物のような活発さで
動いて、棒立ちの肉塊を<ruby>嬲<rt>なぶ</rt></ruby>る。

　亀頭の割れ目に入り込み、押し広げ。
　そうしてから蠢動し、<ruby>擽<rt>くすぐ</rt></ruby>って。

　それでも不足とばかり、唇をそこへ寄せる。
　押し当てて、吸う。

　歯を立てもする。
　軽く、肉に跡をつけない程度に。

　そうしながら、舌も休めない。
　裏筋を弾き、傘を突き。

　いつしか手も、愛撫を再開していた。
　肉茎の根元を指で擦り上げ、掌は陰嚢を包む。

　男性の扱いを知る女性の、巧緻な奉仕。

Even then, I found myself strange.

That I should accept her care so passively did not fit what I knew of myself. Ordinarily, irrational impulses should already have taken command.

But what she called awake was something else.

Blood moved through my body. My nerves woke.

I was coming back to life.

What had been dead in me while I still lived was returning.

Even then, I found myself strange.

That I should accept her care so passively did not fit what I knew of myself. Ordinarily, irrational impulses should already have taken command.

But what she called awake was something else.

Blood moved through my body. My nerves woke.

I was coming back to life.

What had been dead in me while I still lived was returning.

And I followed her lead.

How, precisely? Arre, the omission is still in force. It has not resigned between paragraphs.

What mattered was this: I did not entirely understand her words. She was a stranger, and what she said sounded like a riddle.

Yet I believed I should follow her. Without understanding, I wanted to follow. Something other than reason told Kageaki Minato that this was right, that it was necessary.

She would save me from the wrong ending. She would lead me toward the right one.

That alone was certain. I trusted her without doubt, entrusted myself to her, and answered her care.

Her voice was warm, her eyes still keen and clear. Suddenly I understood.

This was not an act of desire. But it was an act of love.

She loved—not me, but something that included me.

A current surrounding me.

star.

Within it was I, and someone who was not I. An unchanging fate, woven by the two of us as ordained.

She loved it. For some reason, helplessly, she had come to love it.

声は熱く、<ruby>眸<rt>ひとみ</rt></ruby>は怜悧に、女性が俺の行為に報いる。
　――その時ふと、俺は悟った。

　これは情欲の行為ではない。
　しかし愛情の行為ではあった。

　彼女は愛していた。
　俺、ではなく――けれども俺を含む何か。

　俺を取り巻く一つの流れ。

　――――<ruby>運命<rt>ほし</rt></ruby>。

　そこには俺がおり、
　俺ではない誰かがいる。

　不変の運命。
　俺と誰かが定めのままに紡ぐもの。

　彼女はそれを愛している。
　どうしてか、どうしようもなく――愛してしまって
いる。

She guided. I believed.

That was all this was.

An act of love whose reason I did not know.
